title: Hello, C
description:
Change the first program so that it prints exactly these three lines:

```
Hello, C!
C was created in 1972.
It still runs the world.
```

Use one `printf` per line, each ending with `\n`.
hints: Three `printf` calls, one per line, each ending with `\n`. The text must match exactly, including the full stops.
rules: Use three `printf` calls, one per line.

examples.name: the three lines
examples.expected:
Hello, C!
C was created in 1972.
It still runs the world.

rules.message: Use three `printf` calls, one per line.
